open.evidence: John was warm and had already tried calling a CourseRev client number unprompted before the meeting. He said there is "a little bit of a need for the AI" at the facility, while flagging the reservation "I just don't want to lose that personal touch".

post_demo.evidence: Jetan's first reaction was a criticism: "There was just like a huge kind of awkward pause in between while we were waiting", and John added "I thought it might have dropped." Both then kept engaging, asking detailed questions on rate handling, guests, payments and integration.

at_pricing.evidence: John called it "Preferred savings that you mentioned." and later recapped the terms to his GM unprompted and favourably: "they charge uh $250 per successful booking, but we get a preferred rate of $2 per booking if if it's completed". close.evidence: John said "Okay, cool. Right on." after the toggle and month-to-month confirmation, and both John and Jetan gave Bo their mobile numbers when he asked at the end. Against that, John pushed the follow-up out - "I think maybe two to four weeks is more reasonable" - citing "we're just high season right now and lots of meetings and so this is such a new concept".
